key_insight: Bitcoin market sentiment can be classified from a fusion of on-chain blockchain activity, historical price data, and Twitter sentiment, with XGBoost performing best.
engineering_relevance: The study shows that combining heterogeneous financial and social signals with interpretable machine learning can support transparent, data-driven cryptocurrency analytics.
method: Merged on-chain transaction metrics, Bitcoin price history, and daily Twitter sentiment into a normalized dataset.
Tested multiple machine learning models with cross-validation for sentiment classification.
Applied SHAP to explain which on-chain features most influenced predictions.
evidence_signal: Across cross-validation experiments, XGBoost achieved the strongest performance with an average F1-score of about 0.84.
watch_item: Results depend on the quality and alignment of daily social, price, and blockchain data, so time-synchronization and feature leakage need careful control.
paper_title: Decoding Market Emotion from Blockchain Activity: A Data-Driven Sentiment Classifier
